messages:
julia_fin: Heads up — BlueRidge Labs flagged their renewal invoice; they say the platform fee was billed twice during their migration to Dedicated. invoice INV-2026-1202-901 shows Platform Fee x2. can billing confirm? :confused:

mike_billing: grabbing the invoice and contract. which contract id? I'll check the migration events in Zuora.

nina_csm: contract BRL-2022-0012, amendment#5 (migration to Dedicated) was signed 2026-11-25, migration completed 2026-12-01 per infra. customer says we already charged a platform fee on 2026-11-01 renewal then again on 2026-12-02 for Dedicated onboarding.

billing-bot: Invoice INV-2026-1202-901 generated for BRL-2022-0012 — $98,400. PDF: https://invoices.internal/redwood/INV-2026-1202-901.pdf

li_sales: customer email included this snippet: "We accepted the Dedicated onboarding credit for Dec, but invoice shows old platform fee + new Dedicated platform fee. Please correct — we won't pay duplicative platform fees."

mike_billing: looking at billing ledger... we have Platform Fee (annual) $12,000 billed 2026-11-01, and Dedicated Onboarding Platform (prorated) $6,000 billed 2026-12-02. The amendment created a transition rule that should have credited the remainder of the annual platform fee but the transition credit didn't apply due to a mapping mismatch (rate plan id mismatch).

julia_fin: argh. customer expectation is clear. what's the preferred remedy — credit memo or invoice reissue?

eric_fpna: accounting prefers credit memo for reversals on top of the invoice rather than reissuing to avoid AR churn. question: what's the total duplicative amount to credit?

mike_billing: total duplicate = $6,000 (the prorated onboarding platform duplicate). there's also an outstanding onboarding setup fee of $2,500 that is valid (customer agreed). so we should only credit $6k.

nina_csm: customer is asking for the credit to be visible in their portal prior to their payment run on Friday. can we expedite?

mike_billing: I can create CreditMemo-CM-2026-1203-778 for $6,000 and apply to INV-2026-1202-901. but since the amount is >= $5k, we need FP&A notified; Sophie approval required if >= $10k. this is under that so auto-approve path is fine but will notify.

legal-bot: Reminder: any credit that materially changes contractual consideration > $25k requires legal review per Finance-Legal matrix.

eric_fpna: not relevant here. proceed. we do need to tag the revenue impact so we can adjust deferred revenue schedule; please include memo code "platform-dup-brl".

julia_fin: quick check — was the originally billed annual platform fee recognized already? i.e., do we need to reverse recognized revenue or just adjust deferred balance?

mike_billing: recognition run for Nov closed. we've recognized 1/12 on the annual platform fee for Nov. the duplicate onboarding $6k was billed in Dec and sits in deferred revenue. crediting the $6k will reduce deferred revenue. no revenue reversal needed.

julia_fin: ok good. please document in the credit memo note: "Credit for duplicate platform fee during Dedicated migration (BRL-2022-0012)."

mike_billing: will do. creating credit memo now and applying to invoice. posting ETA 15m. attaching draft to thread once created.

billing-bot: Draft Credit Memo CM-2026-1203-778 created for BRL-2022-0012 — $6,000. PDF: https://invoices.internal/redwood/CM-2026-1203-778-draft.pdf

li_sales: customer replied "Thanks — please confirm when the credit posts, we will process payment."

eric_fpna: FYI for the month close: record deferred revenue adjustment under journal JNL-2026-12-REV-ADJ and include memo "platform duplication credit - BlueRidge". I'll pick up the entry once billing confirms posting.

mike_billing: Credit Memo CM-2026-1203-778 posted and applied to INV-2026-1202-901. PDF: https://invoices.internal/redwood/CM-2026-1203-778.pdf

billing-bot: Payment pending for INV-2026-1202-901 (net balance after credit: $90,400). Payment run schedule: Friday 2026-12-09.

sophie_finance: Thanks for the quick turnaround. two asks: 1) add a root cause note in the billing ticket (rate-plan-id mapping bug) 2) add a short process step to the migration playbook to validate transition credits pre-invoice.

julia_fin: will create a postmortem ticket and add playbook item. cc @li_sales for customer comms update.

li_sales: will send a confirmation note to customer and flag CSAT check.

nina_csm: customer confirmed portal shows credit now and will run payment Friday. closing the loop. thanks team :rocket:
